# Iraq Market Intelligence

## When to use
Use when the task requires analyze Iraq-specific access, local customer needs, regional market patterns and lawful constraints.

## Procedure
Identify which user capabilities matter (residency, banks, payout options, language, available hours). Do not assume these from geography. Find credible Iraq-specific requirements and distinguish local from global rules. Output eligibility matrix, missing verification and compliant alternatives.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
